compilation_note_origin.name: compilation_note_origin
compilation_note_origin.value:
CASE "compilation_note"."origin"
        WHEN 'original' THEN "compilation_note"."removed" AND "compilation_note"."source_note" IS NOT NULL AND "compilation_note"."body" IS NULL
        WHEN 'modified' THEN NOT "compilation_note"."removed" AND "compilation_note"."source_note" IS NOT NULL AND "compilation_note"."body" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE NOT "compilation_note"."removed" AND "compilation_note"."source_note" IS NULL AND "compilation_note"."body" IS NOT NULL AND "compilation_note"."after" IS NOT NULL AND "compilation_note"."after" >= 0
      END

compilation_verse_edited.name: compilation_verse_edited
compilation_verse_edited.value: "compilation_verse"."origin" <> 'edited' OR ("compilation_verse"."edit_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "compilation_verse"."source_translation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "compilation_verse"."source_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "compilation_verse"."content" IS NOT NULL)

compilation_verse_own.name: compilation_verse_own
compilation_verse_own.value: "compilation_verse"."origin" NOT IN ('own', 'pasted') OR ("compilation_verse"."content" IS NOT NULL AND "compilation_verse"."source_translation_id" IS NULL)
